craft_notes: Sthāyin: māyā-as-counting (delusion = kalana: the counting-verse, cross-parallel to Parātriṃśikā's). Rows: row 3 (counting→not separately). Close: may be (optative — realities never stand apart, may-be negated on separately). Rejected: 'illusion is naming' — kept counting (kalana is NUMERATION — the precise wrongness); 'categories don't exist' — killed: not-separately kept (they exist, not SEPARATELY).

lines: counting realities' such-natures — not separately may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: māyā vimohinī nāma kalāyāḥ kalanaṃ sthitam | ityādidharmaṃ tattvānāṃ kalayan na pṛthag bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What is māyā? → Māyā is delusion's name — counted realities never stand separately.
c1_essence: Māyā deluding: counted realities never stand apart.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder at identity unmade)
